snippet.title: Chronicles: Medieval | Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Forge your destiny, and rewrite history - welcome to Chronicles: Medieval. Coming to Steam Early Access in 2026, Wishlist now!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2231020/

Trailer narrated by award-winning actor Tom Hardy, with music by The Witcher composer Adam Skorupa.

Chronicles: Medieval lets you step into a vast, dynamic medieval sandbox. Create your character and forge your path from rags to riches. Engage in intense combat, fight for land, glory, and legacy, and lead massive armies into epic, large-scale battles.

Join our Community:
Website: https://www.chronicles.net
Discord: https://www.discord.gg/chroniclesmedieval
X: https://www.x.com/chronicles1313
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/chroniclesmedieval/
